notes: Concurrent incremental peaks 3072 and 5120: the bound is at least 8192 plus the modeled overhead. Independent tasks make every assignment of phases an admitted configuration, so the peaks are summed and not maximized: concurrent_private_peak = 8192 and epoch_peak = 8192 + 768. The two controls straddle the summed figure so the summing is falsifiable rather than merely asserted.

controls.note: The same two peaks under a zero overhead and an allocation of exactly 8192: admitted, with the epoch peak equal to the allocation. This is the upper control of the straddle, and it also shows the overhead is a declared addend rather than a constant folded into the peak.

One byte below the summed peak. A maximized reading would have called 5120 the peak and admitted this too, so the refusal is what makes the summing falsifiable. Both codes are pinned: the credits exceed the allocation and so does the epoch, which distinguishes a per-task check from a whole-epoch one.
